title: Auction-Based Ex-Post-Payment Incentive Mechanism Design for Horizontal Federated Learning with Reputation and Contribution Measurement
reasoning: The paper focuses on designing a technical incentive mechanism for federated learning. While it discusses properties like 'truthfulness' and 'fairness', these are used in a narrow, game-theoretic context to describe the economic properties of the proposed auction mechanism. It does not engage with broader moral, ethical, or religious topics.
